title: limnophila villifera subsp. gracilipes
intro: Limnophila villifera subsp. gracilipes, commonly known as Swamp Basil or Java Basil, is a plant species native to tropical Asia, particularly in the wetlands and swampy areas of Indonesia and Malaysia. The health benefits of this plant include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antibacterial properties, which make it useful in treating various ailments such as fever, cough, and respiratory infections. The therapeutic actions of Limnophila villifera subsp. gracilipes include its ability to reduce inflammation, fight off microbial infections, and exhibit antipyretic activity, thus providing relief from various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and health benefits.
